name: FillFormat
description: Represents fill formatting for a shape.
remarks: A shape can have a solid, gradient, texture, pattern, picture, or semi-transparent fill. Many of the properties of the FillFormat object are read-only. To set one of these properties, you have to apply the corresponding method.
example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
With myDocument.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, _
 90, 90, 90, 80).Fill
 .ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 128, 128)
 .OneColorGradient msoGradientHorizontal, 1, 1
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the specified fill background color.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the specified foreground fill or solid color.

properties.name: GradientColorType
properties.description: Returns the gradient color type for the specified fill. Read-only MsoGradientColorType.

properties.name: GradientDegree
properties.description: Returns the gradient degree of the specified one-color shaded fill as a floating-point value from 0.0 (dark) through 1.0 (light). Read-only Single.

properties.name: GradientStyle
properties.description: Returns the gradient style for the specified fill. Read-only MsoGradientStyle.

properties.name: GradientVariant
properties.description: Returns the shade variant for the specified fill as an integer value from 1 through 4. The values for this property correspond to the gradient variants (numbered from left to right and from top to bottom) on the Gradient tab in the Fill Effects dialog box. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoPatternType value that represents the fill pattern.

properties.name: PresetGradientType
properties.description: Returns the preset gradient type for the specified fill. Read-only MsoPresetGradientType.

properties.name: PresetTexture
properties.description: Returns the preset texture for the specified fill. Read-only MsoPresetTexture.

properties.name: TextureName
properties.description: Returns the name of the custom texture file for the specified fill. Read-only String.

properties.name: TextureType
properties.description: Returns the texture type for the specified fill. Read-only MsoTextureType.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified fill as a value from 0.0 (opaque) through 1.0 (clear). Read/write Double.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns an MsoFillType value that represents the fill type.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: GradientStops
properties.description: Returns the end point for the gradient fill. Read-only.

properties.name: TextureOffsetX
properties.description: Returns the offset X value for the specified fill. Read/write Single.

properties.name: TextureOffsetY
properties.description: Returns the offset Y value for the specified fill. Read/write Single.

properties.name: TextureAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment (the origin of the coordinate grid) for the tiling of the texture fill. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureHorizontalScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal scaling factor for the texture fill. Read/write Single.

properties.name: TextureVerticalScale
properties.description: Returns the texture vertical scale for the specified fill. Read/write Single.

properties.name: TextureTile
properties.description: Returns the texture tile style for the specified fill. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: RotateWithObject
properties.description: Returns or sets if the fill style should rotate with the object. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: PictureEffects
properties.description: Returns a PictureEffects object that represents the picture or texture fill for the specified fill format. Read-only.

properties.name: GradientAngle
properties.description: Returns or sets the angle of the gradient fill for the specified fill format. Read/write.

methods.name: OneColorGradient
methods.signature: OneColorGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long, Degree As Single)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a one-color gradient.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 through 4, corresponding to one of the four variants on the Gradient tab in the Fill Effects dialog box. If _GradientStyle_ is msoGradientFromCenter, the _Variant_ argument can only be 1 or 2.

parameters.name: Degree
parameters.description: The gradient degree. Can be a value from 0.0 (dark) through 1.0 (light).

methods.name: Patterned
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a pattern.

methods.name: PresetGradient
methods.signature: PresetGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long, PresetGradientType As MsoPresetGradientType)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a preset gradient.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 through 4, corresponding to one of the four variants on the Gradient tab in the Fill Effects dialog box. If _Style_ is msoGradientFromCenter, the _Variant_ argument can only be 1 or 2.

methods.name: PresetTextured
methods.description: Sets the specified fill format to a preset texture.

parameters.name: PresetTexture
parameters.description: The type of texture to apply.

methods.name: Solid
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a uniform color. Use this method to convert a gradient, textured, patterned, or background fill back to a solid fill.

methods.name: TwoColorGradient
methods.signature: TwoColorGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a two-color gradient.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 through 4, corresponding to one of the four variants on the Gradient tab in the Fill Effects dialog box. If _Style_ is msoGradientFromCenter, the _Variant_ argument can only be 1 or 2.

methods.name: UserPicture
methods.description: Fills the specified shape with an image.

parameters.name: PictureFile
parameters.description: The file path to the picture file, or the name of the picture file if a link to the picture file currently exists.

methods.name: UserTextured
methods.description: Fills the specified shape with small tiles of an image. If you want to fill the shape with one large image, use the UserPicture method.

parameters.name: TextureFile
parameters.description: The name of the picture file.
